macros.name: tymax
macros.doc: all columns with natural length greater than \tymax are set to the same width (with the proportion being taken as if the natuaral length was equal to \tymax).

macros.name: tymin
macros.doc: To stop very narrow columns being too ‘squeezed’ by this process any columns that are narrower than \tymin are set to their natural width.

envs.name: tabulary
envs.doc: The tabulary environment is similar to tabularx (tools) and tabular* (LaTeX kernel) but uses a different column width allocation algorithm.
